verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's API docs commit to major-version releases for breaking changes, with the old version deprecated, so a basic versioning and deprecation stance is documented. That is a single sentence, not a full policy: nothing covers how versions are selected, notice periods, sunset timelines or a changelog. missing for 10: explicit version identifiers or a version-selection mechanism, deprecation notice period and sunset timeline, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: In the rare case that we do need to break backwards compatibility, we will release a new major version of the API and deprecate the old version.
